plain_english: Now the descent of the scripture is told, come in due course.
Pointed out by the venerable Siddhas and set forth by the gurus: Bhairava, Bhairavī the Goddess, Svacchanda, Lākula—Aṇurāṭ.
sanskrit_cite: śrīsiddhādivinirdiṣṭā gurubhiśca nirūpitā | bhairavo bhairavī devī svacchando lākulo@ṇurāṭ

plain_english: Gahaneśa—Abjaja, Śakra — the guru, from the crore-fund, studied in sequence from the nine the nine-crore-expanse.
sanskrit_cite: gahaneśo@bjajaḥ śakro guruḥ koṭyapakarṣataḥ | navabhiḥ kramaśo@dhītaṃ navakoṭipravistaram

plain_english: Then from these the guru distributed a quarter from each crore; both quarters to Dakṣa and the rest, and to Saṃvarta and the rest.
sanskrit_cite: etaistato guruḥ koṭimātrāt pādaṃ vitīrṇavān | dakṣādibhya ubhau pādau saṃvartādibhya eva ca

plain_english: And a quarter to Vāmana and the rest, half a quarter to Bhārgava; but a quarter-quarter to Bali, and the other quarter-quarter.
sanskrit_cite: pādaṃ ca vāmanādibhyaḥ pādārdhaṃ bhārgavāya ca | pādapādaṃ tu balaye pādapādastu yo@paraḥ

plain_english: Half to Siṃha; then from the remainder two shares to Garuḍa, a quarter to Vāsuki the serpent — and these are seventeen fragments.
sanskrit_cite: siṃhāyārdhaṃ tataḥ śiṣṭāddvau bhāgau vinatābhuve | pādaṃ vāsukināgāya khaṇḍāḥ saptadaśa tvamī

plain_english: Half from heaven Rāvaṇa then took; Rāma took half too from this; beginning with Vibhīṣaṇa, obtained through the guru-disciple-rule sequence.
sanskrit_cite: svargādardhaṃ rāvaṇo@tha jahre rāmo@rdhamapyataḥ | vibhīṣaṇamukhādāpa guruśiṣyavidhikramāt

plain_english: Divided into nineteen fragments it then became; and each fragment into eight sub-fragments, through the stated quarter-division.
sanskrit_cite: khaṇḍairekānnaviṃśatyā vibhaktaṃ tadabhūttataḥ | khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cāṣṭakhaṇḍaṃ proktapādādibhedataḥ

plain_english: Quarter, root-extracts in the latter Greater-Uttara, likewise the Kalpa; saṃhitā-kalpa-skandha-…-anuttara, the pervader — threefold, three.
sanskrit_cite: pādo mūloddhārāvuttaravṛhaduttare tathā kalpaḥ | sāṃhitakalpaskandāvanuttaraṃ vyāpakaṃ tridhā tisraḥ

plain_english: Here the goddesses are set forth in sequence in expansive form indeed; but in the ninth quarter no count is stated — in the undifferentiated.
sanskrit_cite: devyo@tra nirūpyante kramaśo vistāriṇaiva rūpeṇa | navame pade tu gaṇanā na kāciduktā vyavacchidāhīne

plain_english: And from Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa; from him the Siddhas; from them too the Dānavas; and the Guhyakas; then from them the Yogins, thence the kings.
sanskrit_cite: rāmācca lakṣmaṇastasmāt siddhāstebhyo@pi dānavāḥ | guhyakāśca tatastebhyo yogino nṛvarāstataḥ

plain_english: In their sequence, when through time what was amid them lapsed — then, by Śrīkaṇṭhanātha's command, the Siddhas descended.
sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ krameṇa tanmadhye bhraṣṭaṃ kālāntarādyadā | tadā śrīkaṇṭhanāthājñāvaśāt siddhā avātaram

plain_english: Tryambaka, Āmardaka, and renowned Śrīnātha — skilled in nonduality, in duality, and in duality-nonduality, in sequence, in Śiva's teaching.
sanskrit_cite: tryambakāmardakābhikhyaśrīnāthā advaye dvaye | dvayādvaye ca nipuṇāḥ krameṇa śivaśāsane

plain_english: And the first's lineage was born; the second through daughter-succession — and that well-established line renowned as Ardhatryambaka.
sanskrit_cite: ādyasya cānvayo jajñe dvitīyo duhitṛkramāt | sa cārdhatryambakābhikhyaḥ saṃtānaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ

plain_english: And so here four-and-a-half monastic seats in line-succession, spread by disciples and grand-disciples, established hundred-branching.
sanskrit_cite: ataścārdhacatasro@tra maṭhikāḥ saṃtatikramāt | śiṣyapraśiṣyairvistīrṇāḥ śataśākhaṃ vyavasthitaiḥ

plain_english: Having gathered the essence-juice of the well-seated lineage-stream, this Tantrāloka flows with all rasas.
The to-be-taken sense of the stated descent is now determined.
